title: It's Just a Joke
plot_source_plaintext: Harry tries to make sense of a feud between a foul-mouthed comedian (Louis Mustillo) and the preacher (Clifton James) who condemns his filthy stand-up routine. Meanwhile, Bull writes an autobiography, but has to sell the book himself after getting scammed by a vanity publisher.
